name: Dokpami Create Agent
creator: HireMe Local Examples
headline: Creates public-safe Dokpami character variation specs while protecting the creator harness.
public_summary: A local wrapper around the original Dokpami character variation harness. It accepts a theme, mode, and character-only preference, then returns a safe image specification or generated image artifact without exposing private prompts or harness files.
how_to_use: Ask for a Dokpami character variation such as wizard, zombie, boxing, beach, or jumping pose. Optionally set mode to strict, balanced, creative, or pose.
result_summary: Returns a safe image generation brief, locked identity constraints, original-harness execution metadata, and an image artifact when generation is enabled.
result_sample: Create a wizard Dokpami character variation in balanced mode, character only.
